records.observation: JMenuBar with etched border stores applet boolean and actual FirstPanel reference. Builds File Select/Convert/Close/separator/Exit; Edit Preferences; View Reload submenu with Legend window and Timeline window; Help Manual/FAQ/About. Ten corresponding listeners registered; no accelerator/mnemonic, explicit menu enabled-state synchronization, button property listener or setup/renderer call. Applet flag does not remove/disable any menu here; used only by exit listener. Private fields and synthetic accessors expose stored panel/applet to listeners, no static initialization beyond constant serialVersionUID14200. Close and About connect previously constructed FirstPanel buttons that were absent from toolbar; their handlers are reachable through menus. Reload is label only: actual behavior follows button handlers, Legend pack/show versus Timeline worker creation, not log reread by this class. No archived execution.
